_notes.title: The game's name is Krio and stays the same in every language.
_notes.word.bobo: word.<key>: what each Krio word on a tile means. Keep it to one or two words.
_notes.level.fos-step: level.<id>: what each level's Krio name means, shown under the name.
_notes.rule: Under the grid, after a rule like BOBO NA MI. {a} and {b} are word meanings.
_notes.won: Big title when a level is solved. Can stay in Krio ("You win!").
_notes.editor.new_name: The name a new level starts with. Krio for "new level".

title: Bobo na Mi
description: Push Krio words to change the rules, then reach the flag. A puzzle game inspired by Baba Is You.
tagline: Push the words to change the rules!
no_levels: No levels yet. Make one in the level editor!
nobody_you: Nobody na MI! Undo ({undo}) or restart ({restart}).
words.help: Make sentences by pushing word tiles into a line, left to right or top to bottom: THING NA PROPERTY (BOBO NA MI means "boy is you"), or THING NA THING to change one thing into another (ROK NA FLAG). EN ("and") joins more words. Bright tiles are part of a rule.
keys.help: Click a key, then press the new key. Esc cancels, Delete clears.
progress_reset_ask: Clear every ✓ and best number of moves? Your own levels are kept.
editor.name: Level name
editor.new_ask: Start a new empty level? Changes you haven't saved will be lost.
editor.saved: Saved "{name}" in Your levels (your save is {percent}% full).
editor.full: Your save is full. Delete one of your levels first.
editor.export_help: This code is your level. Copy it to share the level: anyone can paste it into Import.
editor.copy_by_hand: Select the code and copy it.
editor.imported: Loaded. Press Save to keep it in Your levels.
editor.turn: Turn: rotate the top thing in a cell
